financialSchemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
financialSchemes.description: Provides short-term credit to farmers for agricultural needs at subsidized interest rates.

financialSchemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
financialSchemes.description: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 annually to eligible farmers.

financialSchemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial support for post-harvest infrastructure and community farming assets.

financialSchemes.name: Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF)
financialSchemes.description: Managed by NABARD to fund rural infrastructure projects.

financialSchemes.name: Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS)
financialSchemes.description: Offers interest rate concessions on crop loans to farmers.

financialSchemes.name: Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs) Scheme
financialSchemes.description: Supports farmer groups with financial assistance for better market access.

financialSchemes.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
financialSchemes.description: An online trading platform for better price discovery and direct market access.

financialSchemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
financialSchemes.description: Promotes organic farming through financial assistance.

financialSchemes.name: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (DEDS)
financialSchemes.description: Provides subsidies for setting up dairy farms and dairy-related businesses.

financialSchemes.name: Livestock Insurance Scheme
financialSchemes.description: Covers financial loss due to livestock mortality.

financialSchemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial support against crop loss due to natural calamities.

financialSchemes.name: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (WBCIS)
financialSchemes.description: Provides insurance based on weather parameters to mitigate financial losses.

financialSchemes.name: Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS)
financialSchemes.description: Covers coconut farmers against natural calamities.

financialSchemes.name: Pilot Unified Package Insurance Scheme (UPIS)
financialSchemes.description: Covers crops, livestock, life, and accident insurance for farmers.

financialSchemes.name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
financialSchemes.description: Financial assistance for the development of livestock, poultry, and dairy sectors.

financialSchemes.name: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
financialSchemes.description: Supports fisheries and aquaculture infrastructure development with concessional finance.

financialSchemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial aid to farmers for purchasing modern agricultural equipment.

financialSchemes.name: National Mission on Horticulture (MIDH)
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial support for promoting horticulture development.

financialSchemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
financialSchemes.description: Financial assistance for fisheries development, including infrastructure and technology.

financialSchemes.name: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC)
financialSchemes.description: Provides credit guarantees and financial support for agribusiness projects.

financialSchemes.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial aid to increase farmers' income through productivity improvements.

financialSchemes.name: Soil Health Management (SHM)
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial support for soil testing and fertility management.

financialSchemes.name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
financialSchemes.description: Provides funding to boost food grain production and farmer income.

financialSchemes.name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana
financialSchemes.description: Supports rural godown construction to reduce post-harvest losses.

financialSchemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
financialSchemes.description: Financial support for irrigation infrastructure and water conservation.

financialSchemes.name: Mega Food Parks Scheme
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial assistance to food processing industries.

financialSchemes.name: National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm (NMOOP)
financialSchemes.description: Financial assistance for increasing oilseed production.

financialSchemes.name: National Bamboo Mission
financialSchemes.description: Promotes bamboo cultivation with financial support.

financialSchemes.name: National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) Schemes
financialSchemes.description: Provides financial aid for dairy development.

financialSchemes.name: Farm Mechanization Scheme
financialSchemes.description: Financial aid for purchasing modern farm equipment.
